dedupe_keys.name: kenya major market locations fsd kenya finaccess survey shared by the american red cross on hdx

description: This dataset gives the locations of major markets in Kenya, collected by Financial Sector Deepening Kenya as part of its FinAccess household survey and shared on the Humanitarian Data Exchange by the American Red Cross. Each record is a market with its name and coordinates, useful where official market registers are not public. Coverage is Kenya, as a snapshot dated January 2019. The data are provided as a linked Google Sheet that can be downloaded as CSV, free under the Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: the list covers major markets only, the sample survey behind it was designed for financial inclusion, not food systems, the sharing organisation's HDX account is inactive, and market days, sizes and commodities are not given. Simulation uses: placing market nodes in food supply and humanitarian logistics models for Kenya, checking market exposure to floods and drought, and linking food price series to locations. Related records: WFP food market locations (data-wfp-food-market-locations) list markets where WFP monitors prices, and Ethiopian market centres (data-ethiopia-market-centers) give a neighbouring country's markets.
